title: Gray Subway Backsplash with Metallic Accents in Midlothian
summary: Kitchen backsplash installation combining gray subway tile with metallic accent bands for a more customized focal wall.
problem: The kitchen needed wall protection and a decorative backsplash treatment that added contrast without overwhelming the existing finishes.
solution: Installed gray subway tile with horizontal metallic accent bands and completed the layout around cabinets, counters and electrical components.
